newsitem.title: JAPAN: Deposit insurance may be used for Osaka union.
newsitem.headline: Deposit insurance may be used for Osaka union.

text.p: Japan's Deposit Insurance Corp (DIC) is expected to provide 200 billion yen to protect depositors with accounts at the troubled Chogin Osaka Shinyo Kumiai, an Osaka-based credit union, a senior Finance Ministry official told a parliamentary committee meeting on Tuesday.
On May 14, the Osaka government announced that five North Korea-related credit unions in Japan would merge into a single institution and take over the operations of Chogin Osaka.
Chogin Osaka's problem loans ballooned after the bursting of Japan's asset bubble in 1990 and the subsequent slowdown in the economy, the Osaka government said.
